```{r setup, include=FALSE}

Sys.setenv(DTMDP_ROOT = root)
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = root)
source(file.path(root, "R", "notebook_code.R"))   # script code without cat() and banner comments
script <- file.path(root, "figures", "fig06_action_mismatch.R")
```

This notebook reproduces Figure 5 of the paper (`output/figures/fig06_action_mismatch.pdf`).
